recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the accepted FHIR-30089 semantic guidance in the authoritative active core source without editing generated diagram artifacts or broadening the change beyond MedicationKnowledge patientCharacteristic.
issue_request: FHIR-30089 was a Published/Persuasive R5 MedicationKnowledge request to change patientCharacteristic.value[x] from SimpleQuantity to full Quantity, add Range for interval expressions, and add guidance for how repeated patient characteristics should be interpreted.
initial_application: Git commit 1683ac64141af807564d62a28932d70133142fb3 applied the datatype portion by removing the SimpleQuantity profile from patientCharacteristic.valueQuantity and adding valueRange. The accepted Jira comment about repeated patientCharacteristic semantics was not present in current source.
additional_context: MedicationKnowledge is active in source/fhir.ini. Later same-family MedicationKnowledge changes moved the original administrationGuideline location into the current MedicationKnowledge.indicationGuideline.dosingGuideline.patientCharacteristic path. Confluence catalog minutes list FHIR-30089 among MedicationKnowledge changes accepted and applied by Pharmacy, and a later Zulip implementer thread confirms the R5 patientCharacteristic remodel addressed age-range use cases.
reconciliation: Added an ElementDefinition.comment to source/medicationknowledge/structuredefinition-MedicationKnowledge.xml stating that different patientCharacteristic types are cumulative while multiple characteristics of the same type are alternatives. The already-correct Quantity and Range value choices were left unchanged.
source_changes: source/medicationknowledge/structuredefinition-MedicationKnowledge.xml: added the missing comment on MedicationKnowledge.indicationGuideline.dosingGuideline.patientCharacteristic explaining cumulative different-type characteristics and alternative same-type characteristics.
